name: Second Breakfast
aka: I Don't Think He Knows About Second Breakfast
look: A still from The Lord of the Rings: two curly-haired hobbits stand side by side among green shrubs with snowy hills behind them. Merry (Dominic Monaghan), in a gray cloak, looks puzzled, while Pippin (Billy Boyd), in a red cloak and knitted scarf, purses his lips awkwardly.
use: Merry and Pippin react with polite disbelief to someone who doesn't know about something they consider obvious and essential. The caption usually follows "I don't think he knows about second breakfast, Pip", swapping in another treat or habit.
slots: bottom: I don't think he knows about ___, Pip
examples: My friend says he has never had a midnight snack
I don't think he knows about second dinner, Pip
The new coworker only eats lunch at noon
I don't think he knows about the 3 p.m. vending machine run, Pip
describe: two hobbits looking confused in front of some trees
merry and pippin making awkward faces outdoors
lord of the rings hobbits shocked that someone skips meals
curly haired halflings in cloaks staring at someone
two short guys in cloaks and scarves look puzzled
origin: Quotes the hobbits' "second breakfast" exchange from The Lord of the Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring (2001).
